rationale: Retain Landmark Dividend LLC as the single canonical active company. The InfraBridge repo-only item is an attribution overlap, not a second company or ownership period. Current company evidence from February 2026 continues to identify Landmark as a DigitalBridge portfolio company and ADIA as a 40% owner. Correct ADIA's vehicle and stake, use the official DigitalBridge-sponsored-vehicles wording, add the official website and Los Angeles headquarters, correct the founding year to 2010 while preserving 2002 as a management-team industry milestone, refresh the concise company description, and add direct evidence to the ownership milestones. The February 2026 Vault disposition was a separate managed joint-venture portfolio exit and does not change Landmark's ownership.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Landmark Dividend acquires, develops, and manages real estate and infrastructure tied to data centers, wireless communications, outdoor media, and renewable power. It serves landowners, corporations, municipalities, and institutions through ground-lease acquisitions and digital-infrastructure investment and operations. Official February 2026 materials describe more than 70 data centers under management and more than 160 employees. Landmark became a DigitalBridge portfolio company in June 2021; ADIA acquired a 40% interest in April 2024 alongside DigitalBridge-sponsored vehicles, and both ownership relationships remained identified by the company in February 2026.
